set.body: Implement lisa(null_spec, stat_vol = NULL, mask = NULL, filter = lisa_bilateral(), tail, q, p0, monotone, backend). Resolve stat_vol/mask/draw/n_perm from neurothresh_null_spec, filter observed and null maps, compute FDR map, and return neurothresh_result with filtered_stat and diagnostics in extras.
set.title: LISA: core lisa(null_spec) inference engine
